_note: Declarative overrides for external executables, read by engines/toolchain.py (find_tool: a cascade of PATH -> THIS file -> conda heuristic). Registering a binary that is not on PATH makes resolution independent of the working directory. Each value may be a string (the path) or {"path": "..."}. A path that does not exist is ignored and the cascade moves on, so a local override is safe even in a versioned file.
_how_to_use: This file ships EMPTY on purpose: the path from whoever published it is of no use to anyone else. If your AutoDock Vina (or another executable) is not on PATH, add it here, for example: "vina": {"path": "/opt/vina/bin/vina"}. The alternative, without editing a versioned file, is to put the binary on PATH.
